title: PART-TIMERS, 57 PLACES BELOW, KNOCK CRAWLEY OUT OF THE FA CUP
description:
Crawley had eighty-one minutes to respond to a nine-minute goal. A part-time side was waiting.

Wimborne Town, a part-time Dorset side, are fifty-seven places below Crawley. Crawley are bottom of League Two. Yang Seung-woo scored after nine minutes. Crawley's interim boss, Kevin Blackwell, made three half-time changes. Then Jackson King's shot went in off Cameron Munn, about eleven minutes from time.

It is the second season running that Crawley lost to non-league opposition in the Cup. Boreham Wood did it last year. The FA Cup is a trapdoor, and Crawley keep stepping on it. Wimborne drew Bradford City in round two. Not bad for part-timers.
